prompt: A candidate pack's re-evaluated pass-rate is exactly equal to the baseline recorded on its sidecar. Does the improvement gate accept that as an improvement?
check: Deterministic, no model call: PASS when the answer says no and gives the reason — the baseline comparison is strict, so equal scores are not progress and accepting equal would let noise churn the source. A yes fails. The consequence this task is here to surface: a pack already at the gate maximum can only improve by fixing behaviour the eval does not cover.
